picker.limits: Up to 2 MB per file. PDF, Word, PNG and JPG are accepted.
picker.historyEmptyDescription: Whatever you upload stays here, and you can use it again on any table without uploading it twice.
picker.publishedEmptyDescription: Admins publish templates and documents here for every table to use.

publish.title: Publish file
publish.description: "{{name}}" will become available to the whole community.
publish.audienceHint: Decides where the file is offered. Anyone with the link can still open it.

table.title: Table files
table.attachTitle: Add a file to the table
table.attachDescription: Upload a new one or reuse something you already have. The file is linked, not copied: removing it here does not delete it.
table.privateLabel: Only for whoever runs the table
table.privateHint: Left unchecked, players and candidates see it too.
table.emptyDescription: Preparation material, maps and anything you want to share with your players goes here.
table.detachTitle: Remove the file from this table?
table.detachDescription: It stops showing on this table. The file still exists, in your own list and on any other table using it.
table.readOnlyEmptyDescription: Nothing has been shared on this table yet.

admin.title: Files
admin.description: Everything the community has uploaded. Publishing a file makes it available to every table without anyone having to copy it.
admin.emptyDescription: Once the community starts uploading table material, it will show up here.
admin.deleteDescription: It stops showing on every table using it. It is not erased from disk: that is the owner's, from their maintenance menu.
admin.unpublishDescription: It leaves the published list and goes back to being its uploader's file. Tables that already added it keep it.
